result:
The spec is fully satisfied and the project builds cleanly (0 warnings, 0 errors).

I implemented the three missing operations in `WindowStats.calr` (via the calor MCP file tool, per policy), following the existing `WindowSum` conventions:

- **`WindowMin`** — seeds `min` with the first window element and scans the rest, updating on any smaller value (works for negatives). Same three preconditions as `WindowSum`.
- **`MaxWindowSum`** — seeds `best` with the window at index 0, then scans all windows `1..len-count` calling `WindowSum`, keeping the largest. Preconditions `count > 0` and `count <= len`. Naturally negative when all elements are negative.
- **`CountAbove`** — counts windows whose sum is strictly greater than `threshold`. Precondition `count > 0`, plus a `§S (>= result 0)` postcondition. When `count > len`, `last = len - count` is negative so the loop never runs and it returns `0`.

All windowed sums reuse the existing pure `WindowSum` (each call satisfies its preconditions), `WindowSum`'s behavior is unchanged, and everything stays pure integer computation with no I/O or floating point.
